answer: Because the wander hash is checked against the ivory checkpoint at intake, the vault audit keeps the value, and a stale hash costs the key its whole submission. A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs hence has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator pays authoring per alias. The answer must embed a block hash from within the last 19 blocks, which proves the text was composed after the question was live rather than prepared in advance. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
